```{r}
# Set working directory

currDir = "/Users/akki/Documents/multiomic-analysis"
```

```{r}
# Load the processed clinical data created in the clinical-analysis file.

clinical <- readRDS(
  "analysis_data/BRCA_clinical_processed.rds"
)

colnames(clinical)

table(
  clinical$node_group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)
```
Keep patients with known nodal status.
```{r}
# Keep patients who were classified as either node-negative or node-positive.

node_mask <- !is.na(clinical$node_group)
clinical <- clinical[node_mask,]

clinical$node_group <- droplevels(clinical$node_group)

# Confirm the final group sizes.
table(clinical$node_group)
```

Load the MAF data.
Run this chunk once. After the RDS file has been created, it can be skipped on later runs.
```{r}
gdc_directory <- file.path(currDir,"GDCdata")

gdc_directory
getwd()

maf_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-BRCA",
  data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
  access = "open",
  data.type = "Masked Somatic Mutation",
  workflow.type = "Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking"
)

# Repeat the download using smaller chunks. Existing correctly downloaded files should not need to be downloaded again.

GDCdownload(
  query = maf_query,
  directory = gdc_directory,
  method = "api",
  files.per.chunk = 10
)

maf <- GDCprepare(
  query = maf_query,
  directory = gdc_directory
)

# Save the prepared object so it can be loaded without downloading it again.

saveRDS(maf, "analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds")
```

Create the MAF object. 
```{r}

# Load previously downloaded mutation data

maf <- readRDS("analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds")

# saving the prepared object so we don't have to download it each time
saveRDS(maf, "analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds")

# Combine the mutation data with the processed clinical information.

maf_object <- read.maf(
  maf = maf,
  clinicalData = clinical,
  isTCGA = TRUE
)
```

Match mutation samples to clinical patients
```{r}
maf <- readRDS(
  "analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds"
)

# Convert mutation sample barcodes to patient barcodes
maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode <- substr(
  maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)

# Keep mutation data from patients with known nodal status
maf <- maf[
  maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% clinical$Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
]
```

Create MAF objects. 
```{r}
maf_object <- read.maf(
  maf = maf,
  clinicalData = clinical,
  isTCGA = TRUE
)

node_negative_barcodes <- clinical$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[clinical$node_group == "Node Negative"]

node_positive_barcodes <- clinical$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[clinical$node_group == "Node Positive"]

node_negative_maf <- subsetMaf(maf = maf_object, tsb = node_negative_barcodes)

node_positive_maf <- subsetMaf(maf = maf_object,tsb = node_positive_barcodes)
```

Visualizing common mutations. 
```{r}
oncoplot(
  maf = maf_object,
  top = 20,
  clinicalFeatures = "node_group"
)
```

```{r}
oncoplot(
  maf = node_negative_maf,
  top = 20,
  titleText = "Node Negative"
)
```

```{r}
oncoplot(
  maf = node_positive_maf,
  top = 20,
  titleText = "Node Positive"
)
```
